info.body:
XOS has no lawful user-mode NIC endpoint or device right. This proposes only reserved/claimed syscall 112 (`sys_net_device`) and a versioned authority, copy, wait and lifecycle contract so a later user-mode network service can use the N1 driver. No syscall constant, dispatch implementation, SDK supported flag or change to existing 1–66 is included; public implementation remains blocked until this registration is reviewed and merged.

The frozen gap probe first exchanges 32 real Ethernet frames on the separate N1 candidate, then confirms ordinary MMIO and PCI OUT attempts fault with vectors 14/13 and restore exact resources. Candidate image/source, SDK and ELF hashes, QEMU command and lossless serial are in `docs/reports/network_device_gap_20261029/`. This is not a TCP/HTTP acceptance result. The proposed grant is explicit and supervisor-controlled; it does not reinterpret spawn-only `sys_process_grant`28.

Validation: documentation consistency passed (457 links, 66 allocated syscalls, 73 historical sources), ABI documentation check and `git diff --check`. Based on fetched upstream 39083f9; independent worktrees preserve PR #17 and existing Qt/GPU work. No main push, merge or Release.

info.body:
XOS previously had no real HTML/CSS browser. This adds Xylophone Browser — Aurora: a Qt6.8.3/QPainter container for pinned liteHTML0.9/Gumbo, the existing Aurora library, a bounded read-only local provider and actual address/back/forward/reload/link/scroll/tab/bookmark interactions inside one native fullscreen window.

B0 target compile/static link and restricted B1 local rendering pass. Five final real XOS/QEMU suites contain47 passed checks, including malformed/oversized content, rejection-to-valid recovery, client/service failure and exact process resource return. The identical VBE and actual VirtIO-GPU2D browser start frames match all1,440,000 RGB bytes. Sources, original licenses, file hashes, ELF/system/SDK receipts, screenshots, raw logs and failed attempts are frozen under `docs/reports/aurora_browser_20261029/`; work log0083 and the engine evaluation define the supported subset. Sampled high water7558pages/3threads is not an absolute peak or stress claim.

No kernel, public ABI, libc or Qt foundation changes. The independent allocation-free URL/HTTP parser has198 host assertions with sanitizers and real XOS process tests, but it is not connected to a transport. HTTP/TCP integration remains blocked on a lawful network service and the separate device registrationPR#18. HTTPS and JavaScript are unavailable and stated in the UI; this is not Chrome/Firefox or general Internet browsing. No3D rendering or static Qt product distribution is claimed.

Validation: final47 browser checks, target undefined-symbol closure, source/SDK hash verification, license-material audit, documentation458links/66syscalls/73historical sources, ABI consistency and whitespace checks. Independent branch from fetched upstream39083f9; no main push, merge or Release.

info.body:
XOS has PCI/VirtIO-GPU support but no real NIC mechanism. This adds a modern VirtIO-Net device backend using the existing PCI discovery/BAR mapping, separate boundedRX/TX queues, actual PIC/INTx completion handling, kernel-owned DMA and reset-before-reclaim. It remains an explicit trusted pre-run diagnostic and quiesces the NIC before ordinary userspace; default startup stays `-nic none`.

N0 reuse/device-contract review and restricted N1 Ethernet pass. Ten network gates cover32 byte-verified bidirectional frames across reset cycles, GPU coexistence, timeout, malformed lengths, pending queue overflow, actual5000-byte merged/jumbo fail-closed handling, no device, allocation quota/repeated reclaim, and ordinary user MMIO/PCI-IO denial. Every successful reset returns34 DMA pages. A same-boot test follows the actual NIC failure/reset with real QtGui pixels, file sync, isolation faults and exact resources. Twenty-one independent affected regression suites pass on frozen build67883ca24e9dcdae: E04, G02, threading, files/persistence, QtCore/Gui/Widgets. The old E04 no-workdisk fixture was blocked by the existing maintenance guard; its failure is retained and its repaired explicit512MiBFAT32 fixture keeps all13 assertions.

Full source/image/SDK/ELF hashes, actual QEMU commands, raw host frames, lossless serial, screenshots, resource counts and failed experiments are in `docs/reports/virtio_net_n1_20261029/`; work log0084 defines the limits. The required MRG_RXBUF negotiation and rejected noMRG experiment are explicit. No shared live IRQ routing, device hotplug, SMP, physical-device or IOMMU qualification is claimed.

Pinned lwIP2.2.1 sources/licenses/member hashes and a bounded NO_SYS cross-compiled archive are included as preparation only. There is no guest IP/ARP/UDP/TCP/DNS/HTTP service, socket ABI or browser networking claim. N2 is BLOCKED on review/merge and actual implementation/acceptance of the separately proposed lawful user-device bridgePR#18. No new syscall/shared SDK interface, user BAR/DMA permission or kernel TCP/HTTP policy is added. Browser local rendering is delivered independently inPR#19.

Validation also includes license-material audit, documentation/ABI consistency, source/artifact reverification and whitespace checks. Based on fetched upstream39083f9. No main push, merge, unrelated workspace changes or Release.
